description: Lossless editing JSON contract for com3d2.menu.

BodySize.description: The encoded byte length of the command region, including its terminal zero byte.
BodySize.title: Command-stream byte length
BodySize.x-meido-edit-guidance: Do not hand-edit it; let the writer recalculate it after Commands changes.
BodySize.x-meido-game-usage: The compiler calculates it from the encoded Commands. The interpreter consumes it as header data but terminates command parsing by argument counts and the zero terminator.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The official compiler extracts name, category, and setumei metadata and writes the ordered command stream and header.
The runtime reads the header and executes the command records in order; command state changes how later records are interpreted.
The editor scans menu commands to build the visible name, description, category, icon, and item state.
The COM3D2_5 text compiler validates additem, category, texture, and item-parameter forms before writing the same CM3D2_MENU stream.
The COM3D2_5 runtime retains the menu interpreter and adds CRC-body, split-item, mesh-morph, and body-state command branches.
The COM3D2_5 editor scan retains the metadata commands and priority/deletion/collaboration flags used by SceneEdit.
SetMatAlpha returns without effect for male skins or unloaded slot objects, then indexes the material array directly and applies the requested alpha.

Category.description: A copy of the category command's MPN category.
Category.title: Header category snapshot
Category.x-meido-edit-guidance: Use an MPN present in the target build and update the category command as well.
Category.x-meido-game-usage: The compiler validates the category and SceneEdit parses the command into an MPN; changing only this snapshot does not change the command result.

Commands.description: The ordered list of command name and string-argument records.
Commands.title: Ordered menu program
Commands.x-meido-edit-guidance: Make local edits only. Preserve order, duplicates, and the context established by preceding records.
Commands.x-meido-game-usage: ProcScriptBin executes records from first to last, carrying category, slot, version, conditional, and temporary state into later records.

InfoText.description: A copy of the setumei command's description text.
InfoText.title: Header description snapshot
InfoText.x-meido-edit-guidance: Update it together with setumei and preserve the game's line-break marker when needed.
InfoText.x-meido-game-usage: SceneEdit displays the command value and converts the game's line-break marker; the header is mainly metadata for readers.

ItemName.description: A copy of the name command's display-name argument.
ItemName.title: Header item-name snapshot
ItemName.x-meido-edit-guidance: Update it together with the corresponding name command.
ItemName.x-meido-game-usage: The editor normally obtains the visible name from the command stream, so this header value can diverge from the effective UI name.

Signature.title: Menu file signature

SrcFileName.description: The lower-case source path or file name copied into the header.
SrcFileName.title: Compiler source name
SrcFileName.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep an accurate source label, but do not treat it as a resource path.
SrcFileName.x-meido-game-usage: The editor uses it for diagnostics; resource loading is driven by command arguments instead.

Version.description: The compiler version marker stored after the signature.
Version.title: Menu format version
Version.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve an existing value; use 1000 when creating a COM3D2 2.48.0 menu.
Version.x-meido-game-usage: The reviewed compiler writes 1000. The current interpreter reads it for alignment but does not select a different command grammar from it.
